hardware: Apple M4 Max, 48 GiB unified memory
protocol: 4 fresh sequential servers in order 8-control, 8-profile, 16-profile, 16-control. Same unmanaged OS cache, one slot, context and batch 4096, microbatch 8, BF16 KV, managed fixed budget, no draft, 8/8 warmup. No prompt reuse. Greedy 912/64, seed 42. Client TPS is 63 divided by first-to-last SSE token time.

measurement.wall: 63 intervals per cap from after sampling the first token through sampling the last token. Step timing starts after bookkeeping for the previous step. Client TPS includes instrumentation and logging. 59 steps preserve natural Metal encoding; steps 8, 24, 40, 56 are timed with encoder boundary markers. Wall attribution uses the 59 natural steps, GPU family estimates use the four marked steps. Means are independent.
measurement.outside_projection: Wall minus delta of the existing expert projection timer. Host attribution partitions the wall: outer backend/event synchronization (including any nested wait in main Metal submit), outer Metal submission excluding sync, CPU split wall minus expert projection, remaining scheduler wall, remaining wall outside splits. Worker expert callback spans were verified to fall within CPU split calls. Input setup, callback and copy metrics are nested observations.
measurement.overlap: Non-overlap intervals use union/intersection on the host monotonic clock. Collect original Metal compute command buffers submitted by the top-level scheduled GPU backend only. GPUStartTime/GPUEndTime bound a command, including any gaps inside it. Intersect their union with outer synchronization intervals. Time outside observed command spans includes scheduling, fences, wakeup, transfers and untracked work; it is not all removable. Async expert submissions are excluded from main-command records.
measurement.categories: Mark tensor allocation provenance in diagnostic-only ggml tensor padding using graph-builder regions: 1 regular attention incl. QSA, 2 linear/recurrent attention incl. projections, convolution, state and output gating, 3 residual Hyper-Connection mixers/combiners, 4 per-layer token embedding block, 5 router/shared feed-forward and associated main graph work, 6 output head including final mixer, 7 other. Only main Metal encoders switch at category transitions. A fused group is attributed to its leading encoded op. Expert CPU callbacks and their nested Metal work are excluded. Per-encoder GPU timestamps are calibrated by paired CPU/GPU timestamps at both ends of the step; on this machine these CPU samples are in nanoseconds. Report unions per category. GPU times overlap host waits. Counter sampling introduces new encoder boundaries and changes timing.
measurement.trace_format: CAP budget; R step host_start_ns host_end_ns cpu_cal_start gpu_cal_start cpu_cal_end gpu_cal_end mach_to_ns; P expert_projection_ns; B main_command_start_ns end_ns status; S/E backend/event sync; W actual Metal waitUntilCompleted; M/C top-level Metal/CPU backend graph call; X whole expert callback; F/J prefetch/copy; D split loop; I graph input setup (each span is host_start_ns end_ns); T category gpu_start gpu_end; E on its own ends a step. Completed command records with zero start time excluded from the GPU union and counted separately.
